title: Pine's Craftable Diamonds
description: A simple mod that lets you craft diamonds from deepslate.
body:
This mod allows you to obtain diamonds from all types of sstone blocks in some shape or form. Below are some of the recipes that can be used to get diamonds.

There is a new recipie in which you can put 9 of any rock type in a crafting table and get 9 deepslate.

There is also a recipe to craft the new "Enriched Deepslate" block which can be crafted by putting raw iron in the middle and surrounding it with deepslate.

There is new blocks with progressing tiers of heat with can either be smelted or blasted. Placing and breaking the blocks will return them to regular enriched deepslate.

The final tier can be made into smaller diamonds with crafting, smithing, and stonecutting which then can be crafted or smithed into a regular diamond.
